arStrings.szText: {c_important}{b}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/b}{/c} are a subpower that the Spiritborn can gain access to via several means, primarily through Legendary Aspects. These feathers appear on the battlefield as you generate them to augment your combat strategies. You can make them provide different benefits such as additional damage or Cooldown Reduction.
